description: A coordinated declaration by mid-sized EU member states, frustrated by paralysis in Brussels and the dominance of Atlanticist agendas, to jointly fund and deploy sovereign AI systems outside the EAAD framework, using national security carve-outs. This creates a splintering dynamic in EU AI policy, with implications for cohesion and leverage. It reflects growing desperation and fragmentation as public sentiment deteriorates and political capital evaporates.
